title: Faculty Heal Tile Rout
prompt:
End-whistle wide storyboard of the Garreg Mach academy mock battle rout finish. Hanneman steps away from a subtle healing-sigil stone tile after casting wind magic; Manuela lowers her hand from white magic support and leaves the adjacent heal-tile ground. Around them, Edelgard, Claude, Black Eagles and Golden Deer students lower wooden or blunted weapons, acknowledging Blue Lions pressure. The field remains one continuous outdoor tactical map with thickets, stone paths, low walls, and monastery background. Supervised nonlethal exercise, no UI.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: ending whistle carries from Dimitri restraint to faculty support line. Transition out: cut back to Felix/Byleth aftermath. Screen/camera rule: faculty heal-tile line is northeast foreground/midground; other enemies lower weapons deeper across the same map. Audio bridge: whistle tail, wood weapons lowering, student breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: wide northeast finish with heal-tile foreground and enemy groups lowering weapons in depth

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: judge podium, teacher arena, separate ring, real war, blood, adult soldiers, missing house colors, chaotic crowd, text, watermark
transition_in: ending whistle carries from Dimitri restraint to faculty support line
screen_direction_rule: faculty heal-tile line is northeast foreground/midground; other enemies lower weapons deeper across the same map
audio_bridge: whistle tail, wood weapons lowering, student breaths
risk_notes: Must show Hanneman and Manuela leaving heal tile+ and other enemies yielding; no judge podium or arena.
